statement: For 2026, social security tax is 6.2% each for the employer and employee on wages up to the $184,500 wage base; Medicare tax is 1.45% each with no wage base limit; and employers must withhold 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax on an employee's wages over $200,000 in a calendar year — withheld from employees only, with no employer share (Publication 15 (2026)).
caveat: The wage base changes annually (SSA announcement; the Additional Medicare Tax return-level threshold varies by filing status even though withholding starts at $200,000 regardless). 2026 figures carry their asOf date and must be re-verified each year; state payroll taxes are entirely separate.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (business-logic tax-mechanics lane 2026-10-01); independent domain expert review pending
